triage.note: S3 restyled src/sec10k/web/static/index.html and found-and-fixed two defects inside the same diff with no case behind either, which hard rule 2 forbids. Round-1 review then found a third of the same species (the hovered row at 4.33:1) and proved the published minima wrong on five pairs, because the original measurement sampled ONE banner variant and ONE badge and generalised. This case is the mechanical floor those three defects needed: it reads the token block LIVE out of index.html, resolves var()/color-mix()/alpha the way CSS does, composites each text color over its real ground stack, and asserts WCAG AA 4.5:1 in BOTH schemes — plus the selector-scoping rule that keeps `button:hover` from outranking `.it[aria-current]`. Deliberately NOT covered: `button:disabled{opacity:.5}` (2.20:1 light), which WCAG 1.4.3 exempts and which is filed as debt rather than silently enforced or silently dropped.

provenance: S3 / PR #18 round-1 repair, created 2026-08-21. Pair table hand-derived from the stylesheet's own rules — every entry names the selector it models in `note` or in its id. Ground stacks follow the paint order the page actually produces: #banner sits on the body (var(--bg)) under a translucent color-mix tint; .it rows sit on #sidebar's var(--panel) until :hover swaps in var(--muted) or [aria-current=true] swaps in the amber wash. WATCHED RED BEFORE THE FIX (hard rule 2), all three reproducible by pointing input.file at the stylesheet named. (A) The pre-fix S3 stylesheet, `git show 3ee3871:src/sec10k/web/static/index.html` — 8 pairs red, floor 3.52:1: row-title-hover 4.33 light (round-1 R1); src-idle 3.52 / src-ok 3.69 / src-amb 3.79 / src-warn 3.88 / src-bad 4.05 light and src-bad 3.92 dark (round-1 R2); badge-missing-selected 4.21 dark, which this case found and review did not. (B) That same file with the light block reverted to the TinBoker palette's raw FILL values from the skill's core-token table (--amber-ink:var(--amber) with --amber 33 92% 44%, --accent 196 88% 40%, --ok 152 64% 32%, --bad 0 72% 50%) — the fill-as-text state S3 fixed with no case behind it: 29 pairs red, floor 1.95:1, caret-amber 2.41 and row-code-hover 2.24, bracketing the 2.40-3.51:1 the author had measured by hand. (C) That same file with `:not(.it)` deleted from the button hover rule — the selector check fires: "unscoped hover rule 'button:hover:not(:disabled)' outranks .it state rules". THE FIX, entirely in the token block: light --dim 40%->38%, dark --bad 61%->66%, and `opacity:.85` dropped from `#banner .src`. GREEN AFTER: floor 4.88:1 dark, 4.57:1 light. CEILING (ponytail): the pair list is declared, not cascaded — a brand-new element/ground combination is invisible to this case until it is added here. The upgrade path is a real CSS cascade, i.e. a browser, which is what this check exists to avoid needing.
